_**Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood**_ is a 2002 [stealth-based](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stealth_game "Stealth game") [real-time tactics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Real-time_tactics "Real-time tactics") [video game](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Video_game "Video game") developed by [Spellbound Entertainment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spellbound_Entertainment "Spellbound Entertainment"). It is similar to games such as _[Desperados: Wanted Dead or Alive](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desperados:_Wanted_Dead_or_Alive "Desperados: Wanted Dead or Alive")_ and the _[Commandos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Commandos_\(series\) "Commandos \(series\)")_ series. In the game, the player controls up to five characters in a setting based on the stories of the protagonist, [Robin Hood](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robin_Hood "Robin Hood"). The player can also control Robin Hood's [Merry Men](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Merry_Men "Merry Men"), including [Little John](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Little_John "Little John"), [Friar Tuck](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Friar_Tuck "Friar Tuck"), [Will Scarlet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Will_Scarlet "Will Scarlet"), [Will Stutely](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Will_Stutely "Will Stutely"), and [Maid Marian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maid_Marian "Maid Marian"). Robin and his crew must evade the cruel [Sheriff of Nottingham](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sheriff_of_Nottingham "Sheriff of Nottingham") and his henchmen and stop the machinations of the vile usurper to England's throne, [Prince John](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John,_King_of_England "John, King of England"). Robin must avoid killing enemies as much as possible, or he will not be able to recruit as many new Merry Men.
